row.body: A barricade kit is packed beside a key marked for return; the inventory lists the weapons as hidden before the road restriction was posted.
row.title: Safe after the barricade

sidecar.gloss: A security cache was hidden before the access restriction appeared.
sidecar.rival_reading: A work crew could have secured equipment before a routine closure; the order of entries does not show who made the call.
